statement: For a continuous adapted chordal Loewner driver W with capacity normalization dg=2/(g-W)dt, if C(X/Y_1) and C(X/Y_2) are local martingales in one filtration on nondegenerate stopped intervals, then W is a continuous semimartingale there with zero finite variation part and local martingale bracket 6dt. A countable covering family gives W=sqrt(6)B globally.
assumptions: countable covering family only for global assertion
source: owner-own-work: w408 ATTEMPT.md, Lemma L1; background SLE normalization from primary literature
proof_or_counterexample: Smooth inversion of one Cardy martingale recovers W as a semimartingale. Ito signed-measure identities for two different right endpoints force d<N>=6dt and dV=0; detailed proof in ATTEMPT.md.
independent_reviewer: w410 (pending); adversary w409 statement handoff attempted
remaining_gap: Actual square-lattice stopped Cardy martingale approximation, joint convergence and boundary-event convention have not been proved.

statement: On compact positive-separation localizations, predictable finite-variation residuals R_i of two Cardy observables determine the driving finite-variation measure and bracket defect by the exact inversion formulas in Lemma L2; their total variation is bounded by the displayed constants.
assumptions: continuous semimartingale driver or smooth inversion of a semimartingale observable
proof_or_counterexample: Invert the two signed-measure equations; triangle inequality proves the variation estimates.
remaining_gap: No lattice drift-measure estimate is supplied.

statement: Joint uniform convergence to continuous paths of an adapted driver and uniformly bounded martingales transfers the martingale identities to the limit's natural joint filtration. A vanishing Cardy approximation then gives the two Cardy martingales of L1.
assumptions: all joint paths adapted to the same discrete filtration
separately justified stopping/convergence of marked Loewner solutions
proof_or_counterexample: Pass bounded continuous past-cylinder martingale tests through weak convergence and use the monotone-class theorem.
remaining_gap: Square-lattice stopped Cardy approximation and compatible joint convergence remain unproved here.

statement: For each kappa>=0, kappa!=6, a locally defined Loewner driver with Brownian variance kappa and drift beta=(6-kappa)(1/X+1/Y)/3 makes one boundary observable C(X/Y) a martingale while a second observable C(X/Z), Z>Y, has nonzero drift. Thus one such martingale does not identify SLE_6.
assumptions: Cardy C normalized as in L1
proof_or_counterexample: Construct X,Y by the displayed SDE, set W=integral beta dt+sqrt(kappa)B, then use Ito. The second normalized drift is (6-kappa)(1/Z-1/Y)/3.
remaining_gap: No mathematical gap claimed in this conditional counterexample; independent audit pending. It does not refute C0017.
independent_review: Scoped mathematical KEEP by w410; see review/w410_verdicts.jsonl; served-model evidence unavailable

statement: Under the standard edge parafermion convention F(e)=E[exp(i sigma W(e,e_b))1_{e in gamma}] and sigma in [0,1] solving sin(pi sigma/2)=sqrt(q)/2, q=1 gives sigma=1/3. The sigma-1 observable has exponent -2/3.
assumptions: signed-radian winding and branch as in Definition 3 of arXiv:1208.3787
proof_or_counterexample: For q=1, sin(pi sigma/2)=1/2 and the sine is strictly increasing for sigma in [0,1], so sigma=1/3. Subtract one for the alternative convention.
remaining_gap: A different conjugation/winding convention must be checked explicitly. This convention correction supplies no missing analyticity identity.

statement: Uniformly vanishing observable errors need not have small total variation: e_n(k)=(-1)^k/n at times k/n^2, k=0,...,n^2, has sup norm 1/n and total variation 2n.
assumptions: n is a positive integer; piecewise linear interpolation optional
proof_or_counterexample: Each of n^2 consecutive increments has absolute size 2/n.
remaining_gap: This refutes only the uniform-error-to-small-variation shortcut, not bounded-martingale transfer or percolation conformal invariance.
independent_review: Scoped mathematical KEEP by w410; see review/w410_verdicts.jsonl; served-model evidence unavailable

statement: Reflection-symmetric one-time marginals and zero unconditional mean do not imply zero conditional driving drift: W_t=Zt for a fair sign Z satisfies those marginal properties, but its past at s>0 determines Z and E[W_t-W_s|F_s]=Z(t-s).
proof_or_counterexample: W_s/s=Z, which gives the displayed conditional expectation.
remaining_gap: Not a percolation construction; it only disproves the marginal-symmetry-to-martingale inference.

statement: For a continuous adapted Loewner driver W with W_0=0, define tau_n for marks (n,2n,3n) by time n or first exit from |W|<n/4, X_n>n/2, both mark gaps>n/2 and Y_2,n<4n. Then tau_n tends to infinity almost surely and sigma_n=inf_{m>=n}tau_m are increasing stopping times tending to infinity. If both Cardy processes are local martingales on every tau_n, the local L1 theorem identifies W globally as sqrt(6) times Brownian motion.
assumptions: Cardy martingale hypothesis for each fixed triple on its predetermined tau_n
source: owner-own-work: GLOBAL_EXHAUSTION.md; explicit-stop/tail-infimum construction suggested by referee w410 and expanded/proved by w408
proof_or_counterexample: Bound g_t(kn)-W below by kn-K on each finite horizon, and the two mark gaps by n exp(-32T/(21n^2)) and n exp(-32T/(77n^2)); hence tau_n>T eventually. The tail infimum is an increasing usual-filtration stopping family. Optional stopping and Levy's characterization complete the conditional argument.
